query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT clienteId) as total_clientes_unicos,
  COUNT(*) as total_atendimentos,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT clienteId), 2) as media_atendimentos_por_cliente
FROM cashbarber_atendimentos
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-morumbi', 'barbiero-mascote')
  AND data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-31'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
